en.headline: 217 own commits across 11 repos, with skill tooling and sandbox docs leading
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode skill tooling, a pixel-art logo CLI and a sandbox knowledge base, plus three releases of the Go model picker.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-25 with no missing days. Across all repositories the account recorded 217 own commits, 1 pull request, 3 issue actions and 0 reviews, plus 571 automated commits, nearly all of them in the profile repository.

### OpenCode skill tooling

The largest single thread was `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, where 83 own commits went into documentation and evaluation work: a SenseNova image skill quick reference with corrections about Windows not needing WSL2, tightened AGENTS.md branch and push rules, a knowledge-ingest command, and eval entries such as the octopus animation reassigned to deepseek-v4.1-flash. One pull request was opened there.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` received 39 own commits and two releases. Version 1.1.0 changed all four actions to return a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and 1.2.0 fixed the list summary counting hidden internal agents, normalized frontmatter booleans, and made a failed sidecar write non-fatal. Work also serialized disable/enable writes to avoid concurrent overwrites.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` got 20 own commits and three releases: 2.0.0 with priced accounting and Console calibration, 3.0.0 cutting the skill from seven Markdown files to two, and 3.0.1 enforcing a candidate menu, per-source chains and a comparing gate. Later commits fixed calibration dates and documented money sources and placeholders.

### Pixel art and reporting tools

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` saw 29 own commits and two releases. Version 0.2.0 was the first tagged release with a bilingual CLI and English-first docs; 0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping, overflow protection with font stepping, and a full CLI manual. Fixes covered missing Pillow fallbacks, Korean text switched to the Galmuri font, and width reserved for right-side decorations.

`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` used 11 own commits for mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 pixels, a single-button theme menu with SVG favicon, visual refinements, and merging three plugins from the resource list. `sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` added 19 own commits porting OpenChamber features, including a hidden-files toggle, an /init skill and a zh-doc-sync skill, plus Chinese documentation.

### Profile, translation and blog

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` had 13 own commits plus 571 automated commits, covering a Dots provider fallback for the daily report, a validation gate in the daily workflow, and fixes so bare issue counts are rejected in summaries. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` documented the Google 2 key path in two commits, and `sogeisetsu/myBlog` added one commit with DSH stats bug screenshots.

### Outside repositories

On `openchamber/openchamber` the account opened issue #5935 about the Settings MCP page omitting the Console MCP server and commented on issue #5879 about temp-file storage management. On `microsoft/PowerToys` it opened issue #52004 about a NullReferenceException in Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation.

Released 3.0.0, reducing the skill from seven Markdown files and about 104k characters to two files and about 8.3k characters.

Opened pull request #1 in the agent sandbox repository.

Opened issue #52004 about Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation throwing a NullReferenceException.
Released v1.2.0, fixing the list summary's hidden-agent divergence count and normalizing frontmatter booleans.

zh.headline: 11 个仓库共 217 次本人提交，技能工具与沙箱文档为主
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入 OpenCode 技能工具、像素 Logo 命令行工具和沙箱知识库，Go 模型选择器连发三个版本。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-27 至 2026-11-25，没有缺失数据的日期。全部仓库合计 217 次本人提交、1 个拉取请求、3 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论）和 0 次评审，另有 571 次自动提交，几乎都集中在个人主页仓库。

### OpenCode 技能工具

投入最多的是 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`，83 次本人提交主要用于文档与评测：收录 SenseNova 图像技能速查并纠正 Windows 不必上 WSL2，收紧 AGENTS.md 的分支与推送纪律，新增 knowledge-ingest 命令，并把章鱼动画等评测条目改归 deepseek-v4.1-flash。该仓库还开了一个拉取请求。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 有 39 次本人提交和 2 个版本。1.1.0 让四个动作统一返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema；1.2.0 修正 list 摘要把隐藏内部 agent 计入差异、统一 frontmatter 布尔值解析，并让 sidecar 写入失败不再导致整体报错。此外把 disable/enable 写入串行化，避免并发覆盖。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 有 20 次本人提交和 3 个版本：2.0.0 引入计价核算与 Console 校准，3.0.0 把技能从 7 个 Markdown 文件压缩到 2 个，3.0.1 强制候选菜单、按来源决定链长并加入比对门禁。后续提交修正校准日期戳并说明金额来源。

### 像素图与报表工具

`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 有 29 次本人提交和 2 个版本。0.2.0 是首个正式版本，提供中英双语命令行；0.3.0 加入自动折行、溢出时按比例缩小字号以及完整命令行手册。修复包括缺少 Pillow 时纯查询命令仍可用、韩语改用 Galmuri 字体、为右侧装饰让出宽度。

`sogeisetsu/dsh-ecosystem-report` 用 11 次本人提交修复 375 与 414 像素真实视口下的移动端布局，把主题切换改为单按钮弹出菜单并补 SVG favicon，做视觉精修，并并入资料库清单中的三个插件。`sogeisetsu/dsh-openchamber-plugins` 有 19 次本人提交，移植 OpenChamber 功能，新增隐藏文件开关、/init 技能和 zh-doc-sync 技能，并补中文文档。

### 主页、翻译与博客

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 13 次本人提交，另有 571 次自动提交，内容包括接入小红书 Dots 作为日报兜底、日报 workflow 增加生成物校验门禁、release notes 全量喂入 AI，以及让摘要拒收裸计数表述。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 用 2 次提交补充 Google 2 密钥获取路径，`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 用 1 次提交加入 DSH 统计页缺陷截图。

### 其他仓库

在 `openchamber/openchamber` 开了 issue #5935，指出设置页 MCP 列表缺少运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务，并评论了关于临时文件存储管理的 issue #5879。在 `microsoft/PowerToys` 开了 issue #52004，描述快捷指南按住 Win 激活时抛出 NullReferenceException。

发布 v0.3.0，加入中英混排自动折行、溢出时按比例缩小字号以及完整命令行手册。
